name: Piyush Gautam
summary:
Chartered Accountant with experience in statutory audits, internal audits, fi-
nancial reporting, IND AS compliance, IFC testing, and taxation. Experienced
in auditing public companies across airport infrastructure, logistics, FMCG,
and advertising sectors. Proficient in SAP and financial statement finaliza-
tion, with strong analytical and stakeholder management skills.
EDUCATION: 1. CA — The Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI) New Delhi (2026) [conf 0.95, review=False]
2. B.Com — University of Delhi New Delhi (2017) [conf 0.95, review=False]
company_details: Total experience: 3.9 years (47 months, 1 overlaps merged)

responsibilities: Conducted statutory audits for 15+ public and private companies across airport, logistics, FMCG, and advertising sectors, ensuring compliance with IND AS and the Companies Act.
Conducted quarterly limited reviews for public & private companies in compliance with SEBI regulations.
Finalized financial statements, notes to accounts, and analytical review procedures for multiple entities.
Identified process gaps and recommended improvements to inter- nal controls and operational efficiency.
Performed Internal Financial Control (IFC) testing, Risk Control Matrix (RCM) reviews, and control effectiveness assessments.
Led revenue audits, vendor audits, and revamp audits for clients across Airport, Advertising, Logistics, and Food industries.
Coordinated directly with senior management and client finance teams during audit execution.
Represented clients before the Deputy Commissioner during VAT assessment proceedings, preparing documentation and support- ing assessment-related submissions.
Assisted in income tax assessment proceedings by preparing and submitting financial statements, reconciliations, and supporting doc- uments in compliance with tax regulations.
Conducted statutory and tax audits for clients across diverse indus- tries, ensuring compliance with the Companies Act, Standards on Auditing (SA), and applicable tax laws.
Reviewed financial statements and tax audit reports to identify dis- crepancies, improve accuracy, and ensure regulatory compliance.
Evaluated compliance with Indian Accounting Standards (IND AS) and assisted in preparing audit observations and recommenda- tions.
Assisted in the evaluation and reporting of Internal Financial Con- trols (IFC) as required under the Companies Act, 2013.
Prepared statutory audit reports and audit documentation in accor- dance with ICAI Standards on Auditing.
Conducted process walkthroughs, tested internal controls, and de- veloped RCMs to identify control gaps and recommend process improvements.
Participated in the physical verification of fixed assets, inventories, and raw materials to validate asset existence and inventory accu- racy.
Verified debtor ageing, statutory dues, contingent liabilities, and other key disclosures to support audit conclusions.
